statement: For each fixed primitive Dirichlet character under its GRH, the unanchored distance for all ordinary length-N Dirichlet polynomials satisfies limsup (log N) Delta_N,chi^2 <= sum m_rho^2/|rho|^2 over distinct nontrivial zeros.
dependencies: fixed-character GRH growth and signed good heights
rational cluster profiles and ordinary integer quadrature

statement: De Roton Thm 2 gives the matching liminf under GRH by continuous-to-integer scale inclusion at lambda=1/N and the complementary function Mellin transform -L(s,chi)/s for nonprincipal chi.
